choices.content: Add the class midpoints and divide by the number of classes.
Add the class frequencies and divide by the number of classes.
Multiply each class's upper limit by its frequency, add the products, and divide by the total frequency.
Multiply each class midpoint by its frequency, add the products, and divide by the total frequency.

question.prompt: How can the mean be estimated from grouped data?

solutions.explanation: After grouping, use each class midpoint to represent the data in that class, then weight by frequency: \(\sum(\text{class midpoint}\times\text{frequency})\div\text{total frequency}\).
solutions.title: Weight class midpoints by frequency
